headline: Granite Industries wins quality award from industry association
body: Granite Industries received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Granite Industries appoints new regional sales director
body: Granite Industries announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Granite Industries faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Granite Industries. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Granite Industries reports record quarterly revenue
body: Granite Industries reported revenue growth of 10% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Regulators open inquiry into Granite Industries labeling practices
body: A regulator opened an inquiry into product labeling at Granite Industries. The company said it is cooperating and that no violations have been established.
